description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade the application runtime to the latest .NET LTS baseline.
tasks.reason: The application currently targets .NET Framework 4.8 and needs a modern supported baseline for Azure-first modernization work.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the project from .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 10 (net10.0) and convert project/build assets as required for a supported migration baseline.

tasks.description: Modernize data access configuration to use Azure SQL Database.
tasks.reason: Assessment identified SQL database connection usage and SqlClient dependency patterns that should be moved to Azure-native authentication.
tasks.requirements: Addresses issues: SQL database connection detected, System.Data.SqlClient dependency detected. Migrate SQL connectivity to Azure SQL Database using managed identity and remove SQL credential-based configuration.

tasks.description: Externalize non-secret application settings to Azure App Configuration.
tasks.reason: Assessment identified hardcoded URL patterns that should be moved out of source-managed configuration into Azure-managed configuration.
tasks.requirements: Addresses issues: Hardcoded URLs detected. Move non-secret app settings from local configuration to Azure App Configuration while preserving application configuration shape.

tasks.description: Scan dependencies for known CVEs and remediate identified vulnerabilities.
tasks.reason: Security remediation is mandatory before cloud deployment to ensure modernized workloads are not deployed with known vulnerabilities.
tasks.requirements: Scan all project dependencies for CVEs and upgrade vulnerable dependencies to patched versions. If major upgrades are required, document breaking-change risks and verify build and tests after remediation.

tasks.description: Deploy the modernized application to Azure Container Apps.
tasks.reason: The project needs an Azure deployment target to run the upgraded and transformed application in a managed cloud platform.
tasks.requirements: Deploy the upgraded application to Azure Container Apps, including required containerization and environment configuration for runtime settings.
